rulebook: Rules and Regulations for Child Care Learning Centers, Ga. Comp. R. & Regs. Subject 591-1-1 (Rules .01-.46), Georgia Secretary of State Rules and Regulations site

items.requirement: A child may be excused from outdoor activities only with documentation of medical contraindication or an occasional written parental request for a very limited time.
items.quote: A child may be excused from outdoor activities for a limited period of time if there is documentation that outdoor activity is medically contraindicated or there is an occasional written request by the parent that the child be excused from outdoor activities for a very limited amount of time because of special circumstances.

items.requirement: Children under three may not spend more than 30 consecutive minutes in confining equipment and must have daily floor play and tummy time.
items.quote: Children less than three (3) years of age shall not spend more than one-half (1/2) hour of time consecutively in confining equipment, such as swings, highchairs, jumpseats, carriers or walkers.

items.requirement: Supervised nap or rest periods must be provided for children under five, and children who do not sleep need not remain lying down more than one hour.
items.quote: Supervised nap or rest periods during the day shall be provided for children under five (5) years of age. Children who do not sleep during nap or rest periods shall not be required to remain lying down for more than one (1) hour.

items.requirement: A daily schedule for each group must be posted in the group's room or area and made available to parents upon request.
items.quote: The schedule must be posted in each group's room or area and made available to Parent(s) upon request.

items.requirement: A child may not be accepted or continue enrollment if the center cannot provide services necessary to protect the child's health and safety.
items.quote: A Center shall not accept a child for enrollment or continue the child's enrollment in the center where the Center Staff determines that services necessary to protect the health and safety of the child while at the Center cannot be provided.

items.requirement: Entertainment media is limited to no more than two hours daily per child or group and must be age appropriate.
items.quote: The use of entertainment media, such as television, videotaped programs or movies and video or computer games shall be limited to: no more than two (2) hours daily per child or group and shall be provided only at times when alternative activities are available for children who choose not to participate.

items.requirement: Animals with vicious propensity, such as pit bull dogs, ferrets, and poisonous snakes, are not permitted on the premises when children are present.
items.quote: No animals, such as but not limited to, pit bull dogs, ferrets, and poisonous snakes, which may have a vicious propensity, shall be permitted on the Center premises at any time there are children on the premises.

items.requirement: A child with a temperature of 101 degrees Fahrenheit or higher plus another contagious symptom must not be accepted or allowed to remain at the center.
items.quote: A child shall not be accepted nor allowed to remain at the Center if the child has the equivalent of a one hundred one (101) degrees Fahrenheit or higher oral temperature and another contagious symptom, such as but not limited to, a rash, diarrhea or a sore throat.

items.requirement: Parents must be notified immediately for professional medical attention, moderate discomfort symptoms, or health and safety risk incidents, and by end of day for less serious symptoms.
items.quote: Immediately notify Parent(s) and obtain specific instructions until child can be picked up or returned to group. When professional medical attention is required, or When child experiences symptoms of moderate discomfort such as elevated temperature, vomiting or diarrhea

items.requirement: Flush toilets and handwashing sinks must be provided in the required ratios for all children, with at least one flush toilet for potty-training children.
items.quote: Flush toilets and hand washing sinks with running water shall be provided in the following minimum ratios for the use of all children:

items.requirement: Parents of all enrolled children must be notified in writing within 24 hours or the next working day of communicable illnesses identified at the center.
items.quote: Parents of all children enrolled shall be notified in writing of the occurrence of any of the illnesses on the most current version of the communicable disease chart, as found on the Department's website

items.requirement: Each child's file must contain evidence of age-appropriate immunizations or a signed affidavit, and no child may continue enrollment more than 30 days without it.
items.quote: The file shall also contain evidence of age-appropriate immunizations or a signed affidavit against such immunizations. The items shall be maintained for each child enrolled in the Center on a form approved by the Department, and no child shall continue enrollment in the Center for more than thirty (30) days without such evidence.

items.requirement: The center must document incidents requiring professional medical attention, including child name, illness or injury, date, how it occurred, staff present, notification method, and services provided.
items.quote: The file shall also contain documentation of incidents requiring professional medical attention, other than simple first aid performed by Center Staff, to include: child's name, type of illness or injury, date of illness or injury, how injury or illness occurred, Staff present, method of notifying Parent(s) and services provided to the child.

items.requirement: Information about enrolled children is confidential and may not be released without written parental permission, except as allowed by rule or emergency.
items.quote: Information pertaining to the children enrolled at a Center is considered confidential and may not be released by Center Staff without first obtaining written permission signed by the Parent(s).

items.requirement: Children may be released only to authorized persons, and staff must verify the person's identity and authorization.
items.quote: The Center shall ensure that children are only released to authorized person(s), and Center Staff shall take necessary steps to determine that any such person(s) presenting to pick up a child in care is authorized by the Parent(s) of the child

items.requirement: Personnel must not use prohibited discipline, including corporal punishment, rough handling, verbal abuse, isolation, restraints, forced feeding, or withholding meals or naps.
items.quote: Personnel shall not: physically or sexually abuse a child or engage or permit others to engage in sexually overt conduct in the presence of any child enrolled in the Center; inflict corporal/physical punishment upon a child;

items.requirement: Diapers must be changed in the child's crib or on a smooth, nonporous changing surface used only for changing, cleaned with disinfectant between each change.
items.quote: Diapers shall be changed in the child's own crib or on a diaper changing surface that is used for no purposes other than changing clothes in each room where infants or any other children wearing diapers are served.

items.requirement: Parents must be notified in advance of a child's participation in any field trip, including destination, date, departure time, and estimated return time.
items.quote: A Center shall notify Parent(s) in advance of a child's participation in any field trip. The notice shall include the name and address of the trip destination, the date of the trip, time of departure and estimated arrival time back at the Center.

items.requirement: Written permission signed and dated by a parent is required before a child participates in any field trip.
items.quote: A Center shall obtain written permission from Parent(s) in advance of the child's participation in any field trip and such permission must be signed and dated by a Parent.

items.requirement: Toys that launch projectiles are not allowed, and balloons must not be accessible to preschool children.
items.quote: Toys that launch projectiles, such as dart guns, pop guns, slingshots, etc., shall not be allowed in the Center, and balloons shall not be accessible to preschool children.

items.requirement: At least 50 percent of caregiver staff present must be trained in pediatric CPR and first aid, with at least one trained staff person in each classroom where children are present.
items.quote: When any child is present on the premises, at least fifty percent (50%) of the caregiver staff present shall be trained in pediatric cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and pediatric first aid.

items.requirement: The center must provide a menu listing all meals and snacks for the current week and retain menus for six months.
items.quote: The Center shall provide a menu listing all meals and snacks to be served during the current week except for School-age Centers where the food may be provided by the Parent(s) by agreement between the School-age Center and the Parent(s).

items.requirement: Foods associated with choking incidents must not be served to children under four, and food must be cut appropriately for each child's age and ability.
items.quote: Foods that are associated with young children's choking incidents, such as, but not limited to, peanuts, hot dogs, raw carrots, popcorn, fish with bones, cheese cubes, grapes and any other food that is of similar shape and size of the trachea/windpipe shall not be served to the children less than four (4) years of age.

items.requirement: Children, parents, staff, or others with symptoms of a contagious communicable disease must not be allowed in the center.
items.quote: Children, Parents, Staff, or any other persons being supervised by the Staff, shall not be allowed in the Center who knowingly have or present symptoms of a contagious communicable disease (such as fever, coughing, fatigue, muscle aches, diarrhea, etc.)

items.requirement: Medications may not be dispensed without specific written authorization from the child's physician or parent, including dosage, dates, and times.
items.quote: Personnel shall not dispense prescription or non-prescription medications to a child without specific written authorization from the child's physician or Parent. Such authorization will include when applicable, date; full name of the child; name of the medication;

items.requirement: Children are not permitted in the kitchen except as part of a planned, supervised learning experience.
items.quote: Children shall not be permitted in the kitchen except as part of a planned, supervised learning experience.

items.requirement: The center must have 35 square feet of usable space per child, excluding kitchens, bathrooms, halls, storage, offices, and adult furniture areas.
items.quote: A Center must have thirty-five (35) square feet of usable space per child. Kitchens, bathrooms, closets, halls, storage areas or rooms, offices, rooms designated for Staff use, other single use areas and space occupied by adult size furniture shall be excluded

items.requirement: The written policies must describe the services provided, including ages served, days and times of operation, and days and times the center is closed.
items.quote: (a) A description of services to be provided which specifies the ages of children to be served, days and times of operations and days and times that the Center is closed;

items.requirement: The written policies must describe enrollment and admission requirements, including parents' responsibilities for supplying information and escorting the child.
items.quote: (b) A description of enrollment and admission requirements which specifies the Parents' responsibilities for supplying needed information to the Center and escorting the child to and from the Center;

items.requirement: The written policies must include a fee and payment schedule covering standard fees, absence and vacation fees, and other charges such as transportation and late fees.
items.quote: (c) A fee and payment schedule that specifies the standard fees, fees related to absences and vacations and other charges and fees such as transportation and late fees;

items.requirement: The written policies must describe the center's transportation and field trip services.
items.quote: (d) A description of the Center's transportation and field trip services (see rule .36 about transportation requirements);

items.requirement: The written policies must describe how medications are handled and how parents are notified of noticeable adverse reactions to prescribed medications.
items.quote: (e) A description of handling administration of medication (see rule .20 about medications), and notifying Parent(s) of noticeable adverse reactions to prescribed medications;

items.requirement: The written policies must describe parental notification for illnesses and injuries and exclusion of sick children.
items.quote: (f) A description of parental notification in cases of illnesses and injury and exclusion of sick children (see rule .07 about children's health);

items.requirement: The written policies must describe parental notification when a notifiable communicable disease is present.
items.quote: (g) A description of parental notification when a notifiable communicable disease is present (see rule .07 about children's health);

items.requirement: The written policies must describe how medical emergencies are handled.
items.quote: (h) A description of handling medical emergencies (see rule .07 about children's health);

items.requirement: The written policies must describe meals and snacks served, including guidelines for food brought from the child's home.
items.quote: (i) A description of meals and snacks served, including guidelines for food brought from the child's home;

items.requirement: The written policies must include permission for parents to access all center areas used by the child.
items.quote: (j) Permission for access by the child's Parent(s) to all Center areas used by the child (see rule .22 about parental access);

items.requirement: The written policies must include child abuse reporting law requirements.
items.quote: (k) Child abuse reporting law requirements;

items.requirement: The written policies must describe behavior management and discipline actions, including practices regarding expulsion and suspension of enrolled children.
items.quote: (l) A description of behavior management and discipline actions used by the Center, to include the program's practices regarding the expulsion and suspension of children enrolled for care.

items.requirement: The written policies must include a nondiscrimination statement.
items.quote: (m) Nondiscrimination statement; (n) Center-sponsored religious and cultural activities, if any;

items.requirement: The written policies must describe any center-sponsored religious and cultural activities.
items.quote: (n) Center-sponsored religious and cultural activities, if any;

items.requirement: If licensed for infants or toddlers, the written policies must describe diapering, toilet training, and feeding procedures.
items.quote: (o) If licensed for the care of an infant or toddler: Center's diapering procedures, Center's toilet training procedures, and Center's feeding procedures;

items.requirement: The written policies must include a written plan for handling emergencies, including evacuation, relocation, shelter-in-place, lock-down, communication, reunification, and continuity of operations.
items.quote: (p) A written plan for handling emergencies, including but not limited to severe weather, fire and other emergency situations (i.e., loss of electrical power or water and death, serious injury or loss of a child, a threatening event, or natural disaster) which may occur at the Center.

items.requirement: The written policies must describe safe sleep practices, including back sleeping, no soft items in cribs, appropriate sleep clothing, individual bedding, and no swaddling without physician authorization.
items.quote: (q) A description of the safe sleep practices followed by the Center that includes the following information: the initial placement of infants on their backs to sleep; no cover or other soft items in crib;

items.requirement: The written policies must describe practices to prevent shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma in children up to five years of age.
items.quote: (r) A description of the practices followed by the Center to prevent shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma in children up to five years of age that includes the following information:

items.requirement: The center must maintain written documentation signed by parents acknowledging that policies and procedures, safe sleep practices, progress, care issues, and participation were discussed.
items.quote: The Center shall have written documentation signed by the Parent(s) in each child's file that the Director or designee has: provided to the Parent(s) a copy of the Center's policies and procedures required by this rule;

items.requirement: The written policies must describe behavior management and discipline actions, including practices regarding expulsion and suspension of enrolled children.
items.quote: (l) A description of behavior management and discipline actions used by the Center, to include the program's practices regarding the expulsion and suspension of children enrolled for care.

items.requirement: The center must provide parents with a copy of the center's policies and procedures.
items.quote: The Center shall provide the Parent(s) with a copy of the Center's policies and procedures as required by this rule.

items.requirement: Custodial parents must be permitted access to all child care areas at any time the child is in attendance.
items.quote: The custodial parent(s) of the child shall at any time the child is in attendance be permitted access to all child care areas of the Center and shall make his or her presence known to Center Staff prior to removing the child from the Center.

items.requirement: The center must comply with applicable fire safety laws and regulations, including a certificate of occupancy if required.
items.quote: A Center must be in compliance with applicable laws and regulations issued by the state fire marshal, the proper local fire marshal or state inspector, including a certificate of occupancy if required prior to receiving any children for care.

items.requirement: Playgrounds must be protected by a four-foot or higher secure fence or other approved barrier.
items.quote: Playgrounds shall be protected from traffic or other hazards by a four (4) foot or higher secure fence or other barrier approved by this Department.

items.requirement: Suspected child abuse, neglect, or deprivation must be reported to the local county DFCS and the Department within 24 hours or the next work day.
items.quote: Within twenty-four (24) hours or the next work day, the Director or designated person-in-charge shall report or cause to be reported any suspected incidents of child abuse, neglect or deprivation to the local County Division of Family and Children Services

items.requirement: The center must post its current license or permit, rules, communicable disease chart, emergency plans, menu, and notice of parents' right to review the latest licensure evaluation report.
items.quote: Each Center shall post in a designated area for public viewing near the front entrance the following: the Center's current License or Permit; a copy of these rules; a copy of the current communicable disease chart;

items.requirement: Staff, chaperones, and students-in-training must not be under the influence of or consume alcohol, marijuana, or other controlled substances on the premises during operation or where children are present.
items.quote: Staff, chaperones and Students-in-Training shall not be under the influence of or consume alcohol, marijuana or other controlled substances on the Center premises during the hours of operation or at any other time or place where there are children present for whom the Center Staff is responsible.

items.requirement: Deaths, serious illnesses or injuries, missing children, fires, structural disasters, relocations, and operating status changes must be reported to the Department within 24 hours or the next work day.
items.quote: The Director or designated person-in-charge shall report or cause to be reported to the Department within twenty-four (24) hours or the next work day: any death of a child while in the care of the Center; any serious illness or injury requiring hospitalization or professional medical attention other than first aid

items.requirement: Each infant must have a safety-approved crib meeting CPSC and ASTM standards, with a firm tight-fitting mattress and individual tight-fitting sheet.
items.quote: A crib that is safety approved in compliance with Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) and American Society of Testing and Materials International (ASTM) safety standards shall be provided for each infant.

items.requirement: Infants must be placed on their backs to sleep unless a physician's written statement authorizes another position.
items.quote: Center Staff shall place an infant to sleep on the infant's back unless the Parent has provided a physician's written statement authorizing another sleep position for that particular infant

items.requirement: The center must establish groupings and maintain staff-to-child ratios by age, including maximum group sizes.
items.quote: A Center must establish groupings of children for care and maintain Staff: child ratios as follows:

items.requirement: Staff must not regularly be scheduled for child care duties for more than 12 hours within any 24-hour period.
items.quote: Staff shall not regularly be scheduled to perform child care duties for more than twelve (12) hours within any twenty-four (24) hour period.

items.requirement: Supervisory and caregiver personnel must complete 10 clock hours of diverse training each calendar year after the first year of employment.
items.quote: Every calendar year after the first year of employment, all supervisory and caregiver Personnel, except independent contractors, Students-in-Training and volunteers, shall attend ten (10) clock hours of diverse training which is offered by an accredited college, university or vocational program or other Department-approved source.

items.requirement: No child may participate in a swimming activity without the parents' written permission.
items.quote: No child shall participate in a swimming activity without the Parents' written permission.

items.requirement: Routine transportation requires written parental authorization specifying pickup and delivery locations, times, and authorized recipients.
items.quote: For routine transportation provided by the Center or on behalf of the Center, the child's Parent(s) must provide written authorization for the transportation and specify routine pick-up location, routine pick-up time, routine delivery location, routine delivery time and the name of any person authorized to receive the child.

items.requirement: Transportation must include current passenger information, emergency medical information, passenger checklists, and vehicle checks by two designated staff.
items.quote: For all transportation conducted by the Center or on behalf of the Center, the following requirements shall be met:

items.requirement: Unless accompanied by a parent, no child may be required to travel more than 45 minutes each trip between the center and destination, excluding field trips.
items.quote: Unless accompanied by his or her Parent, no child shall be required to travel more than forty-five (45) minutes on each trip between the Center and destination point, excluding field trips.

items.requirement: A child must never be left unattended in a vehicle.
items.quote: A child shall never be left unattended in a vehicle.
